scope: Ten reported Dependabot alerts, plus compatible security backports discovered while validating them
scanner_limitation: RustSec skips path dependencies and does not contain all GHSA-only advisories. Backport source provenance and regression tests are required evidence; an omitted scanner finding does not establish a fix.

alerts.resolution: Upgrade 36.0.18 to 36.0.19 and compatible Cranelift packages; also fixes RUSTSEC-2026-0379.
0.13.10 is patched. Legacy 0.12.1 checks oversized SYN Data before allocating a stream; malformed-frame regressions pass on both versions. No dismissal or upstream version relabeling performed.
Backport e8f35e12c2418b04df6e9cdf036005e8aee3c7a2 to 0.11.1+openpayload.1; four error regressions and local QUIC smoke pass.
Remove legacy 0.101.7 via TLS compatibility patch; pin resolved 0.103.16.

Backport bogus-answer rejection to 0.25.2+openpayload.1. Negative-proof errors already propagate in this version. Legacy 0.24.4 uses error-based validation and filters unverified records; current node DNS resolver features do not enable DNSSEC.

No recursive resolver exists in locked 0.24.4/0.25.2 source; stub chains already use only matching answer-section CNAMEs. Regression verifies irrelevant CNAMEs in answer/authority/additional sections cause no followup query on patched 0.25.2.
Remove 0.16.20 by upgrading TLS certificate generator rcgen to 0.12.1; retain 0.17.14.
Backport PR224 iterator fix to 0.12.5+openpayload.1; additionally backport PR238 pop panic-safety fix to both 0.7.8+openpayload.1 and 0.12.5+openpayload.1.
